desc: Design DP state: (product, parity) → bitset of achievable alternating sums; transitions use cheap big-int shifts.
Handle zeros and overflow: cap at limit+1; overflow × 0 = 0; never store empty-subsequence seed.
Implement Solution.maxProduct with add-dict-then-merge per element to avoid reusing the same element twice.
Extract answer: max p ≤ limit with bit (k+1800) set in dp[(p,0)] or dp[(p,1)]; return -1 if none.

Verify against the three given examples plus edge cases — zeros in nums, limit=1, all products overflow, k negative, single element, overflow-then-zero recovery (e.g., nums=[12,0], limit=3, k=12 → product 0); fix any bugs.
